watchdog_ngos_searched: Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN)
adversarial_framing_check_finding: Al Jazeera (Qatari state-funded) framed the Bab al-Mandeb ship attack within a 'cycle of mutual military escalation', attributing the collapse of an earlier lull to a reported Saudi air strike on Sanaa airport, casting Saudi military action as the proximate trigger. Included as a Negative Articles item.
notes: Themed negative/reputational and watchdog searches (each run individually) returned no standalone in-window Aug 11-12 hits; the Riyadh factory fire coverage that killed ~16 Bangladeshi workers is dated 9-10 Aug (out of window, no in-window follow-up found). The two Negative Articles items are: (1) the adversarial-framing hit above (Al Jazeera), and (2) Middle East Eye reporting Emirati backlash to the new Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact. Iranian state media (Press TV, Tehran Times, Mehr, IRNA) were unreachable (HTTP 503 / proxy block) and could not be checked - recorded as an unchecked gap, not evidence of absence.
